notes.direction_rationale: Slight up lean, low-to-medium conviction. For: numbers already cut 14.78% in 30 days, stock already de-rated 16.6% from June, the sequential revenue hurdle (~+16-17% total, ~+19% AUVELITY) is BELOW last year's comparable Q1->Q2 snapback (+24.3% AUVELITY), HRMY confirms the demand environment, operating cash burn already halved to $20.7m, 5 of 7 historical reactions positive, and the last print rose 8.31% on a $0.41 EPS miss. Against: management has surprised on cost twice in three quarters and the one thing it must prove (SG&A levelling out) is unverifiable pre-print; 20/21 Buy with a target 33% above spot leaves only downward revisions available; equity down to $54.6m; fresh Takeda competitive overhang. Separately and with higher confidence than direction: the implied move looks rich - 10.58% priced against a 4.67% seven-quarter mean and a 9.35% realised maximum.
